name: wedding_total_cost
description: Works out the estimated total wedding cost for one case: the dinner cost for all guests plus a list of extra costs such as a DJ or a bar.
formula: total cost = guest_count x dinner_cost_per_guest + the sum of the amounts in extra_costs (an empty list counts as zero)

inputs.name: guest_count
inputs.description: Whole number of guests for this case. Run the module once for each guest count you want to try, for example a lower and a higher one.

inputs.name: dinner_cost_per_guest
inputs.description: What the dinner costs for each guest, in your currency.

inputs.name: extra_costs
inputs.description: Costs that do not depend on the number of guests, one item for each, such as extras, a DJ or a bar. Each item has name (text) and amount (money in your currency). May be an empty list if there are none.

output.description: Estimated total wedding cost for this case, in your currency: guest count times dinner cost per guest, plus all the extra costs.
